_comment: SYNTHETIC Omi conversation-webhook payload (sql/101). Invented people, no real names or phone numbers. Used by scripts/test-omi-ingest.js and as the shape reference for src/memory/omi-ingest.js. Omi POSTs this to <url>?uid=<omi_uid>; the uid is a query parameter, not a body field, and the n8n relay moves it into the X-Omi-Uid header.
